info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Safety Syrup Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Catalog Safety Syrup Detail Management API facilitates the addition of detailed safety information for syrup products in the catalog. This API allows for the structured input of essential data, ensuring that customers have access to vital safety guidelines and precautions. Typical consumers include product managers and developers who maintain product information within a retail or manufacturing context. By utilizing this API, businesses can enhance product safety and compliance, thereby fostering greater consumer trust.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create detailed information about safety syrups, ensuring necessary data is captured for effective management and compliance.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details for the safety syrup operations. It requires a JSON object that contains specific attributes related to the safety syrup for processing. Please ensure that all required fields are included in the request to avoid errors.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the details of the safety syrup.

isPriority.description: Indicates if the request is a priority.

unitPrice.description: Price per unit of the safety syrup.

tags.description: List of tags associated with the safety syrup request.
